objective: Improve the existing app's motion, outside-tap collapse, loading stability and contrast; add authorized Google satellite without changing domain behavior

baseline.source: 141 original files and protected copies unchanged

acceptance_criteria: Sheet transforms run without per-frame layout animation and retain interruption-safe dismissal
Outside taps collapse panels without losing selections or intercepting map drags
Shared press feedback and haptics respect reduced motion and unavailable platforms
Remove UI Theme Contrast; retain system accessibility, predefined material presets, and appearance persistence
Google satellite uses authorized API sessions, current attribution and cancellation-safe layer changes
Existing functionality and original files remain; typecheck, tests, exports and runtime checks provide evidence

decision.action: Refine shared presentation lifecycle and add a satellite adapter around the preserved MapView
evidence: Sheet animates height with useNativeDriver false
ContrastSlider calls measure on every pan move
Existing Google key returned a valid Map Tiles API satellite session
decision.risk: Interrupted animation, attribution layout, asynchronous layer switching

user_amendment: Latest instruction removes UI Theme Contrast from Profile and Preferences; retire its visual override without deleting legacy preferences. Increase Liquid Glass transparency and reflections within tested readability limits. Preserve system accessibility.
